description.text: A wide, static view looks down an empty railway station platform at dusk.
Bare benches line the platform edge, and the tiled floor stretches away in a pale grid, catching the low light from a row of overhead station lamps.
The lamps hang above the walkway against the dimming sky beyond the canopy.
Near the top of the frame, a hanging sign carries the only lettering in view, kept separate from the scene description as supplied on-screen text.
No travellers, staff, or moving equipment appear on the platform; the scene is completely still.
Over this deserted view, an off-screen narrator's voice begins, with no visible speaker entering the frame.
The camera remains fixed, holding the empty platform and the sign within one quiet wide composition.
The camera holds a static shot.
The shot cuts to the same platform, now framed along the track so the sign is outside the view.
A train is drawing away, its carriages sliding steadily into the distance while the platform edge and empty rails remain in the foreground.
The overhead lamps still burn against the dusk, and the benches and tiled floor stay motionless as the last carriage recedes.
Nothing else moves on the platform; the train's departure is the only change in the frame.
The off-screen narrator's voice continues over this departure, completing the line without any visible speaker.
The camera holds a static shot throughout, keeping the receding train and the deserted station in a steady wide view.
The camera holds a static shot.
